# 1. Setup Rstudio and ITHIM Global V2 (75 mins)

-   1.2. Setup rstudio cloud (30 min)

-   1.2. Install the ITHIM-Global V2 package (45 min)

## 1.1. Setup rstudio cloud (30 mins)

### Overview (5 mins)

-   Introduce RStudio Cloud and its benefits for collaborative R work.

    -   What is RStudio Cloud? Cloud-based RStudio IDE accessible via browser.

    -   Key features: no local installation, reproducible environments, easy sharing.

    -   Use cases: teaching labs, workshops, remote collaboration.

### Student account setup (3 mins)

1.  Navigate to https://rstudio.cloud (using the invitation link sent to your email).

2.  Click **Sign Up** with your email registration or choose Google, GitHub etc

3.  Verify your email if prompted.

4.  Briefly explore the dashboard:

    -   **Projects** pane

    -   **Access** and **Settings**

### Creating a project from GitHub (6 mins)

1.  On the dashboard, click **New Project** → **New Project from GitHub**.

2.  In the dialog, enter the repository URL, e.g.: use this toy project (light)

    ```         
    https://github.com/your-org/your-course-repo.git
    ```

3.  (Optional) Specify a subdirectory if the repo has multiple labs.

4.  Click **Create Project**. Wait for the cloud environment to launch.

5.  Tour the new project workspace:

    -   Console, **Files** pane, **Plots**, **Help**.

    -   The cloned repo appears in **Files**.

### Opening and running code (4 mins)

-   In the **Files** pane, locate the starter script, e.g., `lab1.R` or `analysis.R`.

-   Click to open it in the editor.

-   In the console, run:

    ```         
    source("lab1.R")
    ```

-   Verify that the code executes and produces output (plots, tables).

### Q&A and next steps (10 mins)

-   Recap:

    -   Account setup

    -   Project creation from GitHub (pulling from GitHub)

    -   Running starter scripts

-   Answer any immediate questions.

-   Direct students to lab instructions in the README.

## 1.2. Install the ITHIM-Global V2 package (45 mins)

-   Your landing page for the ithim-global-v2 package will look like the figure below

    ![](images/landing_page2.png)

-   When you click on the project (START), it should create a copy like this (\~5 mins)

    ![](images/clipboard-2289141768.png)

-   Once the ITHIM project is open

-   Run the following lines to install/update the required packages \~25mins

    -   renv::install() #(installs most of the needed packages/dependencies) (\~1min)

    -   renv::install("meta-analyses/drpa") #(adds the drpa package that failed to install) (\~20 mins)

    -   install.packages(c("plotly", "ReIns", "distr", "pracma", "truncnorm" )) #(add other packeges) (\~3 mins)

-   Build a functional package from the downloaded scripts as follows: (\<1min)

    ![](images/build_package.png)

-   We may ask you to pull changes to the exercises from GitHub. In that case, follow the steps below:

    -   Click on the Git–\>pull buttons shown in the figure

        ![](images/git_pull.png)

    -   These changes will pertain to the exercises, so you can follow the instructions in the exercises

    -   If we have made some changes to the model itself, you will need to rebuild the package as detailed above and in the vignette

        -   Vehicle distances
